description: Nucor Corporation, a Delaware corporation incorporated in 1958, and its affiliates manufacture steel and steel products, and the company also produces and procures ferrous and non-ferrous materials primarily for use in its steel manufacturing business, with most of its operating facilities and customers located in North America and its operations including international trading and sales companies that buy and sell steel and steel products manufactured by the company and others. Nucor is North America's largest recycler, using scrap steel as the primary raw material in producing steel and steel products, and in 2025 it recycled approximately 20 million gross tons of scrap steel. It reports its results in three segments, steel mills, steel products and raw materials, with the steel mills segment its largest, representing 62 percent of sales to external customers in the year ended December 31, 2025.
